Engraved map of the British fortifications at the mouth of the Oswego River (now in city of Oswego, N.Y.) as depicted by the French.

Engraved map of the British fortifications at the mouth of the Oswego River (now in city of Oswego, N.Y.) as depicted by the French. Shows military actions taken in the capture of Fort Oswego (August 1756). Relief shown by shading and rock drawings. This map originally appeared in the atlas "Les plans de la guerre de sept ans" issued in parts between 1789 and 1791 in Mainz (Germany). Includes index of battle sites and actions titled "Renvois". Number in margin at lower right: Lit. c. N'ro 2. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault
